11 Regarding the performance of business loans, banks were queried about expectations for the performance 
of four types of C&I loans (nonsyndicated loans, syndicated nonleveraged loans, syndicated leveraged loans, and 
loans to small firms) and three types of CRE loans (multifamily loans, nonfarm nonresidential loans, and 
construction and land development loans). 
12 Foreign banks, on net, reported expecting standards to remain basically unchanged for C&I loans to large 
and middle-market firms. A modest net share of foreign banks also reported expecting improvement in the quality 
of syndicated nonleveraged C&I loans to large and middle-market firms. On balance, foreign banks expect the 
quality of nonsyndicated C&I loans to large and middle-market firms to remain basically unchanged over 2024.
